skill.name: tmnl-color-system
skill.description: TMNL color system architecture and surface hierarchy. Invoke when implementing color schemes, glow effects, status indicators, or debugging color inconsistencies. Defines the surface progression and accent palette.

generated_query: I'm building a new status indicator component for monitoring dashboard cards. Each card shows a system service with one of three states: active (green), warning (amber), or error (rose). I need the indicator to have a small dot that pulses with a subtle glow, and a label next to it showing the state name. The component must reference the existing color tokens from the Vantablack system (canonical source: `src/components/portal/tokens.ts`) and follow the surface hierarchy for the card background. Specifically, the card background should use the 'base' surface, and the dot should use the appropriate accent color and its associated glow effect. The label text should match the text hierarchy for secondary content. Could you generate the code for this component? For input, I'll pass a `status` prop of type `'active' | 'warning' | 'error'`. The output should be a styled React component that renders the dot and label with correct colors and a box-shadow glow. Also, ensure you're importing the tokens correctly so there are no hardcoded hex values.
